title: Claude Fable 5 & Mythos 5
content:
## Overview

On June 9, 2026, Anthropic released **Claude Fable 5**, the first publicly available model from its Mythos model class. Fable 5 and its less restricted sibling **Claude Mythos 5** share the same underlying weights but differ in how safety fallbacks are applied.

Three days after launch, on June 12, 2026, the US Commerce Department issued an export-control directive requiring Anthropic to suspend access to both models.

---

## Model Architecture: Fable vs. Mythos

Anthropic split the Mythos-class release into two products:

| | Claude Fable 5 | Claude Mythos 5 |
|---|---|---|
| Access | General availability | Approved cybersecurity & life sciences partners |
| Safety fallbacks | Yes — sensitive requests route to Opus 4.8 | No automatic fallback |
| Fallback rate | < 5% of sessions | N/A |
| Model ID | `claude-fable-5` | `claude-mythos-5` |

For the 95%+ of sessions that don't trigger a fallback, Fable 5 performs identically to Mythos 5.

---

## Key Capabilities

- **Always-on adaptive thinking** — extended reasoning is enabled by default, not an opt-in mode
- **1 million token context window** — the largest context window of any Claude model
- **128K output tokens** — matches the output limit of Opus 4.8
- **Vision and computer use** — full multimodal support including GUI automation
- **Agentic task performance** — designed for long-horizon multi-step tasks

---

## Benchmark Results

| Benchmark | Fable 5 / Mythos 5 | Opus 4.8 | GPT-5.5 |
|---|---|---|---|
| SWE-Bench Pro | 80.3% | 69.2% | 58.6% |
| GDPval-AA (agentic real-world) | 1932 (#1 ranked) | — | — |
| Cybersecurity eval (Mythos 5) | 78.0% | 40.0% | — |

Mythos 5's cybersecurity score (78.0%) is nearly double Opus 4.8's (40.0%), which is a primary reason the US government cited the model as a national security concern.

---

## Project Glasswing Preview

Before the June 9 public release, Anthropic ran **Project Glasswing** — a restricted preview program starting in April 2026. Partners included AWS, Microsoft, Apple, and CrowdStrike, working with a version marketed as "Claude Mythos Preview."

Glasswing partners recorded SWE-Bench Pro scores of 77.8% with Mythos Preview, confirming substantial capability gains ahead of general availability.

---

## Pricing

- **Input:** $10 per million tokens
- **Output:** $50 per million tokens

This is 2× the price of Opus 4.8 ($5/$25 per million tokens). From June 9–22, Fable 5 was included on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans at no extra charge during the launch window — before being pulled due to the export directive.

---

## US Government Export Control Suspension

On June 12, 2026 — three days after launch — the US Commerce Department issued a legally binding export-control directive requiring Anthropic to suspend access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for all foreign nationals, including non-citizens residing in the United States.

Access was disabled at 5:21 p.m. ET on June 12. Anthropic stated it had no choice but to comply and described the situation as a misunderstanding it was working to resolve. Less capable models (Opus 4.8 and below) were not affected.

The directive specifically cited the model's code-generation and vulnerability-identification capabilities as posing national security risks.
